notes: Inclusion A002383\{3} subset of A085104 cap A059055 holds (A002383_sub: k^2+k+1 = 111_k = ((k+1)^3+1)/((k+2)), Lean). Reverse inclusion open: equivalent to every prime (n^q-1)/(n-1) = (b^r+1)/(b+1) with odd q, r >= 5, n, b >= 2 being of the form c^2+c+1; this is the Goormaghtigh equation with one negative base (y = -b). Search: no common value with q, r >= 5 up to 10^26. Outside Lean: the reduction (exponent 3 on either side gives c^2+c+1; even digit count gives composite) and the search.
